**Finding submitted — WARRANTY: deviation (fallback cure inserted).**

- **Investigation:** § 8 is Client-side only; § 9 "TRUELINK WARRANTIES" is limited to Y2K date processing; § 3 hosting commitments are "reasonable commercial efforts" (response time, availability, backups) rather than warranties; §§ 2(i) and 3(h) expressly disclaim data accuracy; § 12 contains the implied-warranty disclaimer and liability cap. No conformance warranty, no services performance warranty, and no remedy exist anywhere — the fallback fails on every element.
- **Cure:** one insert after p0060 adding 90-day software conformance to documentation, a 30-day professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, and repair/replacement, re-performance or refund as our remedy.
- **Noted, not flagged:** the disclaimer is prefaced "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT", so it does not swallow the new express warranty; no carve-out edit was needed, and preferred-level extras (12-month software term, compliance-with-laws, malicious code) were deliberately not volunteered at the fallback target.
